Next-Gen Connectivity
High-impact advancements in FY 24-25
We enable businesses to navigate through their digital 
transformation needs with scalable, on-demand, agile 
and multi-cloud enabled solutions. 
IZOTM Multi Cloud Connect
IZOTM Multi Cloud Network
We introduced IZOTM Multi Cloud Connect 
Network Hub and VNFaaS (VNF as a Service) 
to address customers’ multi-cloud, large and 
complex cloud landing zone problem.
Network As a Service Capability
We integrated Network as a Service with IZO™ 
Multi Cloud Connect and IZOTM Multi Cloud 
Network to deliver new differentiated offerings by 
seamlessly incorporating multi-cloud connectivity 
into the existing enterprise architecture of 
the customers. This integration enhances 
operational efficiencies and provides global 
connectivity for users.
Managed Wi-Fi and LAN Services
Coupled with our existing WAN and SDWAN 
portfolio, we started to provide and integrate 
LAN to WAN offerings for customers during the 
year under review.
We introduced a full-stack cloud networking 
solution called IZOTM Multi Cloud Network, which 
includes IZOTM Multi Cloud Connect and IZOTM 
Multi Cloud Network ensuring seamless cloud 
access, frictionless application management and 
granular security.
Extended Access Flexibility for IZOTM Internet WAN
We are continuously developing our integrated 
solutions to expand our coverage through both 
wireline access and Low Earth Orbit (‘LEO’) 
satellite connectivity to offer fast deployment and 
high-speed back-up alternatives for expanded 
reach and resilience.

Digital-first enterprises need seamless, secure, 
and agile networks that simplify end-to-end user 
to cloud application experience management. 
Our Cloud Connectivity solutions, powered by full 
stack of IZOTM Multi Cloud Connect and IZOTM Multi 
Cloud Network Solutions eliminate the distance 
between users and applications, reducing friction 
and building trust. This coupled with Integrated 
LAN-to-WAN solutions, our global coverage 
with wireline & LEO satellite-based access and 
Network as a Service ('NaaS') offerings in underlay 
connectivity solutions, enable this flexible, end-to-
end enterprise networking architecture.
